data: IDeS Lab full-market daily file (TaiwanStockPrice format, incl. delisted), 2017-01 to 2026-10-30; ex-dividend/split adjustment from tw_dividend_events.csv
universe: each day: top 300 by 20-day average traded value among 1,661 common stocks that ranked in the top 450 at any time since 2018
rebalance: last trading day of each week; signal at close, trade at next open
weighting: equal at entry; rebalanced only when >20% off target

random_baseline.rule: same universe, same number of names, same retention count per rebalance, same minimum holding

benchmark_0050.note: 0050 adjusted close incl. 2025-06-18 1:4 split, same window; computed 2026-11-02 (FinMind data); not recomputed in this run
